Releases

Changelog

Every release of uidna-mcp. The schema keeps its own changelog in packages/schema.

0.3.1Version 0.3.1 2026-10-20

Changed

  • The schema is published as uidna-schema (npm install uidna-schema), and uidna-mcp depends on it. @rohzzn/uidna-schema is deprecated and points there. Nothing in the schema or the tools changed.

0.3.0Version 0.3.0 2026-10-20

Completes Phase 2 with responsive-rule inference and search, filter and sort inference, each proven end to end on the new Fixture B (an orders dashboard) in real Chromium.

Added

  • Responsive-rule inference: scan_interface reads the width conditions of readable stylesheets and resizes between the scanned widths (resize only, every non-GET request blocked) to locate where the layout changes. Located breakpoints, with their bracket, explaining condition and the layout values that change, are in visual.responsive (schema 0.3.0) and in the scan result. responsive input to tune or turn it off.
  • The generator declares the located breakpoints and attributes each style change to the breakpoint that explains it; the verifier checks the generated layout on both sides of every probed breakpoint (responsive comparisons in the DiffReport).
  • Search, filter and sort inference: tables, lists and card grids become collections (schema 0.3.0) with item identity, fields and value kinds; transitions that narrowed or reordered them become search, filter, sort and reset rules with the field, match, predicate or order that explains them, and the empty-state message of an empty result.
  • explore_interactions tries the search box of a collection with a query taken from its items, then one that matches nothing, then clears it; collections: false skips it.
  • Generated collections render their items through search, filter and sort state, with aria-pressed and aria-sort following it; the verifier compares the items shown after a replay with the original's by identity and order, and generated tests assert them.
  • Fixture B and its end-to-end acceptance test, in the CI matrix.

Changed

  • The CLI and MCP server are published as uidna-mcp: npm install -g uidna-mcp, or npx uidna-mcp. npm does not accept the name uidna (too close to an existing package), so the scoped @rohzzn/uidna is deprecated and points here. The command is still uidna; the package also installs it as uidna-mcp. The schema stays @rohzzn/uidna-schema.
  • Exploration blocks every non-GET request for the whole run: an action that sends one is a side effect that never reaches its server. A control repeated in every item of a collection is one action: after a side effect it is skipped in every item.
  • Captures keep identity attributes (data-id and similar) and table scope, colspan and rowspan.
  • A click toggle whose changes span several section files (a menu button in the header and the drawer it opens in the main section) shares one state through src/lib/shared-state.ts instead of being left out.
  • Absolutely and fixed positioned boxes keep the inset they are anchored by and their measured width, and drop the opposite inset, which the browser resolves to the scanned width; a box stretched by both insets keeps both.
  • A flex or grid container taller than its children keeps its height (margins never collapse there), unless its own flex or grid parent stretches it.
  • Together with the shared toggle state, these changes took the generated Fixture B dashboard from 112 to 116 of 116 matched transitions and from 2 to 3 of 3 breakpoints matched on both sides.
  • The HTML report shows each page's route from the generated project's manifest, and says when a page was not generated.

Fixed

  • act() waits for the popup of a click whose request the guard already saw, so a slow popup report under load no longer makes the click count as performed.
  • uidna setup registers npx -y uidna-mcp@latest serve. With the bare package name, npx run inside a checkout of this repository resolved to the checkout and the server failed to start; the tag also keeps agents on the newest release.
  • uidna doctor reports an unreachable Chrome on the default debugging port as optional information. It is a problem only when an endpoint is named with --cdp or in config.
  • CI uses actions/checkout, actions/setup-node and actions/upload-artifact v7, which run on Node 24.

0.2.0Version 0.2.0 2026-10-14

Phase 2: sites, forms and data. Every capability is an end-to-end CI gate on its own fixture in real Chromium.

Added

  • scan_interface and reconstruct_interface take crawl: { maxPages, include, exclude }: a breadth-first crawl of same-origin links within the page budget. Cross-origin links are recorded and never followed. Results list the pages with their depth and the link that discovered them.
  • captureBodies: "json" stores JSON responses from fetch and XHR as redacted, size-capped data assets.
  • explore_interactions explores every page, records clicks on links to another crawled page as navigation transitions, and reports coverage per page. pages narrows it.
  • The forms exploration policy fills forms with synthetic values (formValues overrides them per control) and submits them empty and filled. Validation states keep aria-invalid, the error message and native validity. Every submission request is blocked, recorded as a side effect and never repeated, in the same run or a later one.
  • generate_project writes one component per page behind react-router with the shared header and footer in a layout (router), forms that reproduce the observed validation without sending a request, a typed mock per data asset, and Playwright behavior tests in tests/behavior.spec.ts (behaviorTests).
  • verify_reconstruction renders every page at its route, replays fills, blocked submits and same-origin navigations, and runs the generated Playwright suite with runGeneratedTests. A failing generated test becomes a behavior finding.
  • Fixture C (a signup form with validation, a POST endpoint and a JSON list) and Fixture D (a three-page site), each with an end-to-end acceptance test.

Changed

  • The CLI and MCP server are published as uidna-mcp: npm install -g uidna-mcp, or npx uidna-mcp. npm does not accept the name uidna (too close to an existing package), so the scoped @rohzzn/uidna is deprecated and points here. The command is still uidna; the package also installs it as uidna-mcp. The schema stays @rohzzn/uidna-schema.
  • Transitions that caused a side effect are never replayed, by the verifier or by the generated Playwright suite, which skips them with the reason.
  • explore_interactions remembers side-effect controls per page, so a control on one page no longer hides a control at the same position on another.
  • Generated-test and build processes are killed with their whole process tree on Windows when they time out or are cancelled.
  • The forms policy holds its non-GET guard for a whole form chain, from the first step to the fresh load that reverts it. Requests a page sends while unloading, such as beacons and keepalive fetches, are blocked through the DevTools Protocol because Playwright routing cannot see them.
  • Form chain steps find their control again after an earlier step changed the form, and skip with a reason when it can no longer be matched.
  • Side effects caused by revert steps, by actions the browser reported as not performed, by navigations to pages without a capture at that width, and by page-level keys are attributed to their action and remembered.
  • The generator and the verifier share one replay tracer. A state reachable only through a side effect is never replayed, and its generated test is skipped with the reason.
  • The verifier takes page routes from the generated project's manifest when it was generated from the same scan. Pages the generator left out are reported, not compared.

Fixed

  • A page-controlled field name such as constructor no longer resolves to a built-in object member when the forms policy picks a synthetic value.
  • A stale generated-test report from an earlier attempt is never read as the current one.
  • Literal routes that contain a colon, such as /wiki/Help:Contents, are matched as literal paths.
  • Requests of a document replaced by a navigation are settled as abandoned. They used to stay in flight forever, so every later stability wait ran to its timeout.
  • verify_reconstruction never runs the behavior tests of a project generated from another scan, whose transition ids name other transitions; a limitation says why.

0.1.0Version 0.1.0 2026-10-13

Added

  • Phase 1: the single-page loop from URL to verified React project. Capture at several viewports, safe exploration with revert, token clustering, component fingerprinting, agent annotations with inferred provenance, a deterministic React + TypeScript + Tailwind + Vite generator, and a verifier with pixel, SSIM, geometry, style and behavior comparison across attempts.
  • Twelve tools with one evidence envelope over MCP and the CLI, plus setup and doctor.
